Behind him, shelves are stocked with various colorful bags of coffee beans. Lighting is bright studio-style. (2) Close-up shots feature a high-end, polished chrome espresso machine with a distinct lever arm and a golden eagle statue ornament on its top cap. (3) The expert picks up a dark, textured ceramic coffee filter. He rotates it to reveal the inside, showing many small hand-poked holes on the bottom surface. (4) The camera cuts to the interviewers: a man wearing a black cap, black t-shirt, and glasses, and a woman in a brown cardigan. They lean in and gesture while reacting with curiosity. (5) A series of close-up shots demonstrate water being poured from a thin-spouted kettle into different coffee drippers, including a red ceramic one and a silver metal one with fluted paper filters. (6) The man in the floral shirt holds a small conical terracotta dripper and a metal wire-frame dripper. He points to the inner walls to illustrate technical design differences. (7) The video ends with a reaction shot of the male interviewer followed by a black screen featuring bold yellow and white text overlays and a brand logo.
